provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Watergate rules (Frosted Games / Capstone, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Pick roles: Editor and Nixon Administration
Board between you, right way up for the Editor
Each: take your role's 21 cards; momentum card faceup by your side of the research track; shuffle your 20 player cards as your draw deck
Initiative card faceup between the momentum cards, arrows pointing to the Editor; End of round card beside it
Initiative token and 1 momentum token on the 0 space; the other 8 momentum tokens as a supply
The 7 picture tiles beside the board: the potential informant supply
The 30 evidence tokens into the bag
Each round draw the number on your side of the initiative card (4 or 5)
Each round Nixon draws 3 evidence tokens, looks, and places them facedown on 0
Used events leave the game; conspirators and journalists go to your discard pile
A token pushed to space 5 on your side is gained at once
Editor pins evidence faceup, Nixon facedown
The player the initiative arrows point to (the Editor) plays first
